source: mock fixtures for stage 0 (task brief); passwords are stored as PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 digests, the plain-text values exist only in README/tests
notes: Test accounts are fixed fixtures for QA and demos: customer@picpac.test / Test1234 and support@picpac.test / Test1234.
Only a salted PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 digest of Test1234 is stored here, in the form pbkdf2$<iterations>$<saltB64>$<hashB64>; the mock compares derived keys and never logs a password.

challenge_demo is a pre-armed one-time-code challenge: POST /v1/auth/verify {challengeId: 'challenge_demo', code: '0000'} returns a customer session. Five wrong codes burn the challenge (410 challenge_expired).
